title: Disarm Traps to Unlock Boxes Concept I Threw Together
author: SlopMachinez
selftext:
There used to be these old MUDs (Dragonrealms and Gemstone IV) I played back when I was a teen in the 90’s. There were these boxes that people would bring back from fighting monsters. As a rogue your job if you specialized in it would be to disarm and unlock the boxes. I wanted to make a physical game similar to it so here’s the first concept.

IMO MMORPGs should have done this a LONG time ago. Rogues could keep the trap parts and sell them and people would tip the rogue for opening their box. Huge missed opportunity in MMORPGs.
